authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1, 20.4.55, 20.4.56, 20.4.65 and 20.4.66
scope: STYLE_CONTROL 0x3, Standard STYLE 0x11, APPID_CONTROL 0x9 and ACAD APPID 0x12 in the locally generated AC1012 pair.
checks: CRC-checked physical frames and exact data/handle boundaries are bound for both drawings. The controls have one role-2 entry each; both rows have relative role-12 control owners and typed null extension/xref. STYLE fields include font txt, zero fixed height, width 1 and last height 0.2; APPID's undocumented byte is zero.

Every wrong-role mutation and byte-prefix truncation is refused, followed by successful original-frame retry. The adapter's corresponding style and application names, handles, owners and selected style values match; both generated inputs and the shared vector CTest pass.

Independent cadkit-dwg 0.5.4 decodes the selected source STYLE fields and APPID name. The peer labels R13 untested; its APPID result is not claimed as an independent interpretation of the undocumented byte. The updated handoff packet includes four frame hashes. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: Decoded font spelling and fields do not establish native font availability, style validity, AutoCAD normal-open, dictionary cloning behavior, whole-file closure or output support.
